headline: Daemen win for the first time this season
dek: Daemen, who have conceded thirty goals, more than any other programme, won on the road at Roberts Wesleyan for the first victory of their season. The same evening Queens, who had won every match since the defeat at Holy Family, lost at home to Staten Island without scoring.
displaced_by: Daemen's first win of the season, at Roberts Wesleyan; Queens beaten at home by Staten Island

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Queens have scored 22 goals, more than any other programme, and nine different players have scored them; the attack is spread across the side rather than carried by one striker.

wire.line: Queens' first home defeat of the season came against Staten Island, the first match in which they have failed to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match is past its date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens have conceded eight goals all season, and the home defeat to Staten Island was the first match in which they did not score.

last_match.line: Staten Island's other away win, at Dominican, also came without conceding a goal.

next_match.line: Neither has lost in conference play; Molloy have yet to concede away from home, and D'Youville have won their last two at home.
